critical_code_review_comments: RegisterIn.preferred_language correctly typed as Optional[Literal['es','en']] — invalid values (e.g. 'fr') are rejected by Pydantic with 422 before hitting DB. user_doc stores BOTH 'language' and 'preferred_language' fields with the same value (defaults to 'es' when not provided). Verified via direct mongo lookup post-register.

_badges_for_provider correctly checks languages array for {es, en} subset before appending bilingual badge. Confirmed on María (languages=['es','en']) and badge appears in /providers/{id}/badges payload as 4th badge with key='bilingual' label='Bilingüe · Bilingual' icon='🗣️'.

Snapshot endpoint admin-gated via require_admin (returns 403 for provider, 401 for unauth). Idempotency works via existence check `db.coupons.find_one({user_id, month_key})` inside _create_coupon_for_provider — re-running for 2026-05 returns the same coupon_id+code without inserting duplicates.

Coupon redeem endpoint correctly returns 404 for non-owner (find_one filtered by both coupon_id AND user_id), 400 for already-redeemed, 400 with auto-expire on past redeemable_until, and 400 before redeemable_from with Spanish message 'El cupón aún no es redimible.' All branches confirmed by tests.

Notification + queue creation paths fire on first mint only (gated by user.email/phone presence). The 'notification_key' uses '{user_id}::coupon::{month_key}' pattern which is unique per user-per-month and prevents re-triggers on idempotent snapshot reruns (only the notifications.insert_one happens inside _create_coupon_for_provider AFTER existing-check returns None, so this is naturally idempotent — verified by tests).

Frontend ProviderCTASection cleanly switches both card titles, body copy and CTA labels via useI18n's t() — both ES ('latinos y americanos', 'El sol sale para todos') and EN ('Latino and American', 'The sun rises for everyone') verified in DOM via language switch.

Register.jsx correctly parses ?lang=es|en URL parameter and seeds preferredLanguage state. Selected button uses border-teal-600 (ES) or border-blue-600 (EN) with bg-{color}-50 + text-{color}-800 — provides clear visual selection state.
CouponsCard renders null when no coupons (clean — no empty state clutter on the dashboard). DOM-order between LeaderboardWidget and ShareLinkCard verified visually and by bounding-rect comparison.
